name: Current regime
derivation: Train breadth is 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40. Nearest-rank median on four values takes index round(0.5 * 3) = round(1.5) = 2 under banker's rounding, so the cut is the THIRD value, 0.30. Then: 0.50 is above the cut and labels HIGH; 0.05 is below and labels LOW; 0.30 sits exactly ON the cut and labels LOW, because the comparison is strictly greater-than. The boundary case is the reason this vector exists - > and >= are both defensible and only one is implemented.
note: expected is the fitted cuts first (breadth then volatility), then one label per query
